checks.title: Confirm finance goal and owner
checks.instructions: Record the legal entity or business scope, named decision owner, reporting period, timezone, currency, excluded actions, and the first useful finance outcome.

checks.title: Verify authoritative records
checks.instructions: Identify billing/payment and finance/ledger source of truth, exact account or export, live/test mode where relevant, date coverage, and freshness. Keep invoiced, collected, recognized, and pending payout measures distinct.

checks.title: Agree on policy and metric
checks.instructions: Record invoice terms, refund/contact rules, approval thresholds, exception priority, metric definition and baseline or baseline-first decision. Do not invent missing policies.

checks.title: Bind two ready Crews
checks.instructions: Record two distinct authorized Crew IDs with billing-operations-coordinator and finance-analyst selected skills and verified setup. Optional close/payables slots require their own access and check evidence.

checks.title: Test source access
checks.instructions: Read a representative authorized record or export in each required Crew. Verify that no credentials or connections are copied across Crews. Record the reduced behavior when only partial data exists.

checks.title: Validate the billing handoff
checks.instructions: Validate a real billing-exception-queue/v1 and finance-impact-readout/v1 with the bundled deterministic validator. Save run IDs, artifact paths, and results; prove the invalid fixture blocks the consumer route.

checks.title: Review the Automation plan
checks.instructions: Show actual Crew IDs, source access, bounded fields passed, validation steps, cost/budget, action approval points, and manual activation state to the owner.

checks.title: Run the first route manually
checks.instructions: Record one real bounded two-Crew manual run with source references, validator results, finance readout, exceptions and blockers. Do not mark complete from a fixture alone.

checks.title: Track reviewed decisions
checks.instructions: Record stable case/action IDs, source links, owner, proposed versus approved state, exact next action, and follow-up date. A draft message, refund proposal, or bill queue is not an executed action.

checks.title: Choose run policy
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed paused schedule/event with timezone, concurrency, retries, budget, notifications, and source freshness. Completion does not itself enable recurrence.
